traps.signal: A previous machine's username, Desktop, OneDrive label, or checkout root is reused.
traps.avoid: Resolve the current machine profile and role; consume pathRoles.developmentCheckout instead of remembered paths.

traps.signal: A detected profileId is treated as the operator/environment role.
traps.avoid: Keep machine profile classification separate from explicit environmentRoleId.

traps.signal: Machines sharing a path convention are treated as the same operational role.
traps.avoid: Preserve personal-windows-laptop, desktop-workstation, admin-box-1, and admin-box-2 as distinct bindings.

traps.signal: Setup, repair, or live certification continues after a nonzero prerequisite.
traps.avoid: Stop at the first failed dependency and preserve the last proven state.

traps.signal: A handoff emits a bare repository command that fails from another working directory.
traps.avoid: Emit a command with the resolved repository-root path and propagate the child exit code.

traps.signal: A local emergency patch is followed by pull-and-run against the same checkout.
traps.avoid: Commit/push isolated work, refresh remote truth, verify the exact SHA, then execute.
